headline: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg's massive AI manifesto
summary: Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto on AI's future. He envisions humanity co-existing with advanced artificial intelligence. The essay outlines his beliefs on AI's broad impact and development.

headline: Apple will stream Friday Night Baseball live in Vision Pro
summary: Apple Vision Pro will stream Friday Night Baseball starting August 28th. Immersive video will feature live commentary and spatial graphics. Game replays will be available on Apple TV app after broadcast.

headline: Keychron's wireless Hall effect keyboard is back to its lowest price
summary: Keychron's K2 HE wireless Hall effect keyboard is on sale for $103.99. This price matches its lowest historical discount on Amazon. The aluminum-clad keyboard offers customizable Hall effect sensors.

headline: What happens to Bose when headphones become AI?
summary: Bose CEO Lila Snyder discusses the company's future with AI integration. Bose, a 60-year-old audio brand, faces evolving tech landscapes. The interview explores the impact of AI on headphones and wearables.

headline: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 Gets Huge Boost 3 Years After Launch Thanks to Box Office Phenomenon Spider-Man: Brand New Day
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day movie sparks huge interest in Marvel's Spider-Man 2. The game is seeing a surge in reinstalls and new purchases. This boost comes three years after the game's initial launch.

headline: Curtis '50 Cent' Jackson Joins Payday TV Show as Executive Producer
summary: Rapper Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson is joining the Payday TV show. He will serve as an executive producer for the Starbreeze Entertainment series. The addition brings an unexpected name to the gaming adaptation's team.

headline: Nintendo Is Giving Away a £50 Switch 2 Accessory With Its Latest Console Bundle
summary: Nintendo's new Switch 2 bundle offers a free accessory. The accessory, worth up to £49.99, comes with a console, game, and NSO plan. It's a significant deal for those looking to purchase a new Switch.

headline: Saros Is Back Down to $50 at Amazon, Its Lowest Price Yet
summary: Housemarque's PS5 sci-fi shooter, Saros, is now $50 on Amazon. This marks the game's lowest price point ever recorded. Physical copies of the title are available at this discounted rate.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A record 230 individuals crossed the Channel in a single small boat. The Home Office condemns the "reckless and dangerous tactics" of gangs. This highlights the use of unseaworthy vessels for mass crossings.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: A woman claims Travelodge staff gave her abuser a key to her room. Her attacker then kicked the hotel room door off its hinges. The incident raises serious concerns about hotel security protocols.

headline: Consortium including Jeff Bezos advances talks for stake in Liverpool FC
summary: A group, including Jeff Bezos, is in advanced talks to buy a stake in Liverpool FC. The consortium aims for approximately a 30% share in the football club. BBC Sport confirmed the potential high-profile investment.

headline: Ex-Cambridge professor Jason Arday cancels live event after plagiarism row
summary: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday canceled an event. The cancellation follows a recent plagiarism controversy. Other talks have also been removed from listings at his request.
